Specification — Cantilever Circular Shaft with Multiple Applied Torques.
A solid circular shaft of diameter d = 30 mm and total length L = 1200 mm is fixed (built-in, clamped) at x = 0 and free at x = L.
The material is AISI 1020 steel with shear modulus G = 76923.1 MPa, and the analysis uses N, mm, MPa, and rad.
A torque T₁ = +200000 N·mm is applied at the free end x = L = 1200 mm in the positive sense.
A torque T₂ = −200000 N·mm is applied at x = 400 mm in the opposite rotational sense.
The analysis uses small-deformation, linear-elastic, homogeneous, isotropic Saint-Venant torsion with uniform circular cross-section, neglecting stress concentrations at load introduction points and self-weight.
Global torque equilibrium requires T_R(0) + T₁ + T₂ = 0, giving T_R(0) = 0, so the fixed-end reaction torque is zero.
The internal torque T(x) at any section equals the algebraic sum of all externally applied torques lying to the right of the cut at coordinate x.
The polar moment of inertia of a solid circular cross-section is J = πd⁴/32.
The maximum shear stress at the outer surface is τ_max(x) = T(x)(d/2)/J = 16T(x)/(πd³).
The rate of twist is dφ/dx = T(x)/(GJ).
The angle of twist between two stations is φ(x₂) − φ(x₁) = ∫_{x₁}^{x₂} T(x)/(GJ) dx.
The fixed-free cantilever boundary conditions are φ(0) = 0 and zero internal torque at the free end.
For a solid circular shaft, cross-sections remain plane and warping is identically zero under Saint-Venant torsion.
Computed polar moment of inertia: J = π(30)⁴/32 = 79521.6 mm⁴.
Computed torsional rigidity: GJ = (76923.1 MPa)(79521.6 mm⁴) = 6.1170 × 10⁹ N·mm².
Internal torque distribution in segment 0 ≤ x < 400 mm is T(x) = T₂ + T₁ = 0.
Internal torque distribution in segment 400 < x ≤ 1200 mm is T(x) = T₁ = +200000 N·mm.
Maximum shear stress in segment 0 ≤ x < 400 mm is τ_max(x) = 0.
Maximum shear stress at the outer surface in segment 400 < x ≤ 1200 mm is τ_max = 16(200000)/(π × 30³) = 37.72 MPa.
Rate of twist in segment 0 ≤ x < 400 mm is dφ/dx = 0.
Rate of twist in segment 400 < x ≤ 1200 mm is dφ/dx = 200000/(6.1170 × 10⁹) = 3.269 × 10⁻⁵ rad/mm.
Angle of twist in segment 0 ≤ x < 400 mm is φ(x) = 0.
Angle of twist in segment 400 < x ≤ 1200 mm is φ(x) = (T₁/GJ)(x − 400).
Angle of twist at the free end is φ(L) = (200000 × 800)/(6.1170 × 10⁹) = 0.02616 rad = 1.499°, with the free end rotating in the +T₁ sense relative to the wall.
The point of zero twist is the entire segment 0 ≤ x ≤ 400 mm (including the wall and the torque application point x = 400 mm).
The point of maximum shear stress is the entire outer surface (r = 15 mm) along 400 ≤ x ≤ 1200 mm.
